va_robot_trill.notes: Fast, wide pitch vibrato makes an intentionally artificial squealing melody. Saw oscillator; 5900 Hz VA low-pass with 55% resonance; amplitude ADSR 1/330 ms, 73% sustain, 185 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 9.7 Hz, +/-94 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_nasal_pipe.title: Nasal Pipe
va_nasal_pipe.notes: Narrow, pipe-like lead shaded by a gently moving phaser; useful above a dense bass part. Square oscillator; 9500 Hz VA low-pass with 24% resonance; amplitude ADSR 11/280 ms, 79% sustain, 195 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 4.2 Hz, +/-8 cents. Shared band-pass at 2850 Hz. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_velvet_key.title: Velvet Key
va_velvet_key.notes: Soft electric-keyboard impression with a rounded attack and a playable sustaining body. Triangle oscillator; 3100 Hz VA low-pass with 13% resonance; amplitude ADSR 4/1300 ms, 16% sustain, 430 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_square_clav.title: Square Clav
va_square_clav.notes: Clipped, hollow pluck with a dry keyed-string character and a small amount of drive. Square oscillator; 4300 Hz VA low-pass with 34% resonance; amplitude ADSR 0/165 ms, 0% sustain, 50 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_tiny_mallet.title: Tiny Mallet
va_tiny_mallet.notes: Small rounded sine mallet with a delicate room tail; especially useful in the upper register. Sine oscillator; 13000 Hz VA low-pass with 0% resonance; amplitude ADSR 2/660 ms, 0% sustain, 220 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_bark_key.title: Bark Key
va_bark_key.notes: A woody, resonant keyboard bark whose loudness fades into a small held body. Saw oscillator; 1850 Hz VA low-pass with 76% resonance; amplitude ADSR 1/650 ms, 9% sustain, 180 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_damp_string.title: Damped String
va_damp_string.notes: Soft long pluck with a clean harmonic outline; finger release damps it before the full decay. Triangle oscillator; 9500 Hz VA low-pass with 21% resonance; amplitude ADSR 1/1820 ms, 0% sustain, 380 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_droplet.title: Droplet
va_droplet.notes: Clear little droplet followed by a short repeat; compact enough for a sequenced counterline. Sine oscillator; 15000 Hz VA low-pass with 0% resonance; amplitude ADSR 0/310 ms, 0% sustain, 95 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_piped_key.title: Piped Key
va_piped_key.notes: Compact square-wave organ tone with a firm hold and a deliberately clean stop. Square oscillator; 5200 Hz VA low-pass with 9% resonance; amplitude ADSR 3/70 ms, 94% sustain, 65 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_tack_key.title: Tack Key
va_tack_key.notes: Bright saw keyboard strike with enough dry edge for rhythmic chord parts. Saw oscillator; 6700 Hz VA low-pass with 18% resonance; amplitude ADSR 2/1050 ms, 7% sustain, 260 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_velvet_air.title: Velvet Air
va_velvet_air.notes: Low, soft cloud of saw harmonics with slow chorus and a rounded hall tail. Saw oscillator; 1490 Hz VA low-pass with 11% resonance; amplitude ADSR 820/1900 ms, 75% sustain, 2550 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 2.1 Hz, +/-5 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_glass_tide.title: Glass Tide
va_glass_tide.notes: Pure tone carried through a slow pitch tide and a long cloud reverb; intentionally sparse harmonically. Sine oscillator; 16000 Hz VA low-pass with 0% resonance; amplitude ADSR 740/2100 ms, 79% sustain, 3200 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 0.34 Hz, +/-74 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_bronze_sky.title: Bronze Sky
va_bronze_sky.notes: Hollow square pad with a bronzed moving notch and a wide chorus halo. Square oscillator; 2600 Hz VA low-pass with 24% resonance; amplitude ADSR 380/1250 ms, 72% sustain, 1900 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 3.3 Hz, +/-7 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_soft_fire.title: Soft Fire
va_soft_fire.notes: A bright slow swell with a long rounded release; a warm harmonic bed behind a lead. Saw oscillator; 5900 Hz VA low-pass with 17% resonance; amplitude ADSR 1600/2000 ms, 74% sustain, 2900 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 1.8 Hz, +/-5 cents. Expressions 2: Enabled subtle pitch motion and stronger slow chorus. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_silk_string.title: Silk String
va_silk_string.notes: A gentle string-like saw ensemble impression using chorus rather than oscillator unison. Saw oscillator; 7100 Hz VA low-pass with 10% resonance; amplitude ADSR 240/900 ms, 81% sustain, 1250 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 5.6 Hz, +/-8 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_breath_wall.title: Breath Wall
va_breath_wall.notes: A continuous, unpitched wall of warm breath with its middle band brought forward. Noise oscillator; 2400 Hz VA low-pass with 23% resonance; amplitude ADSR 950/2200 ms, 63% sustain, 2150 ms release. Noise is unpitched; note number does not retune it. Shared band-pass at 920 Hz. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_frozen_dust.title: Frozen Dust
va_frozen_dust.notes: A thin upper-air noise cloud, designed as a texture rather than a pitched chord instrument. Noise oscillator; 14500 Hz VA low-pass with 16% resonance; amplitude ADSR 1450/2800 ms, 45% sustain, 3450 ms release. Noise is unpitched; note number does not retune it. Shared high-pass at 4700 Hz. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_whale_song.title: Whale Song
va_whale_song.notes: Very slow, wide pitch drift with long echoes; hold notes to let the contour develop. Sine oscillator; 2200 Hz VA low-pass with 9% resonance; amplitude ADSR 2100/2400 ms, 85% sustain, 3650 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 0.16 Hz, +/-96 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_warp_tape.title: Warp Tape
va_warp_tape.notes: Rounded pad with audible slow wow, subdued chorus and irregular-feeling fixed-time echoes. Triangle oscillator; 4900 Hz VA low-pass with 17% resonance; amplitude ADSR 90/1650 ms, 77% sustain, 1850 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 0.67 Hz, +/-43 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_swamp_wave.title: Swamp Wave
va_swamp_wave.notes: A low resonant growl with slow moving notches and gentle pitch undulation. Saw oscillator; 620 Hz VA low-pass with 89% resonance; amplitude ADSR 460/1250 ms, 68% sustain, 1580 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 1.22 Hz, +/-33 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_magnet_fog.title: Magnet Fog
va_magnet_fog.notes: Dense hollow pad with a pronounced slow phaser sweep and a quiet chorus halo. Square oscillator; 2400 Hz VA low-pass with 54% resonance; amplitude ADSR 1150/1900 ms, 67% sustain, 3250 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 0.31 Hz, +/-14 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_radio_ghost.title: Radio Ghost
va_radio_ghost.notes: Narrow noisy whistle-like colour drifting through chorus and phaser; no stable musical pitch is promised. Noise oscillator; 9400 Hz VA low-pass with 22% resonance; amplitude ADSR 250/2250 ms, 45% sustain, 1850 ms release. Noise is unpitched; note number does not retune it. Shared band-pass at 2350 Hz. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_crystal_mist.title: Crystal Mist
va_crystal_mist.notes: Bright upper-register pad with a quick wide vibrato and a shimmering chorus texture. Triangle oscillator; 14500 Hz VA low-pass with 12% resonance; amplitude ADSR 690/1500 ms, 62% sustain, 2950 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 7.3 Hz, +/-40 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_sonar_loop.title: Sonar Loop
va_sonar_loop.notes: A pure short sonar ping repeated in eighth-note echoes; notes and rhythm remain easy to hear. Sine oscillator; 4000 Hz VA low-pass with 0% resonance; amplitude ADSR 0/510 ms, 0% sustain, 190 ms release. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_orbit_beacon.title: Orbit Beacon
va_orbit_beacon.notes: A narrow musical siren with fast pitch movement and phaser-coloured reflections. Square oscillator; 5100 Hz VA low-pass with 36% resonance; amplitude ADSR 85/680 ms, 34% sustain, 950 ms release. Pitch sine LFO 2.4 Hz, +/-100 cents. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.

va_rust_bloom.title: Rust Bloom
va_rust_bloom.notes: A slow noisy bloom that fades even while held, with grit and moving spectral notches. Noise oscillator; 11000 Hz VA low-pass with 49% resonance; amplitude ADSR 2350/1650 ms, 0% sustain, 1250 ms release. Noise is unpitched; note number does not retune it. Shared high-pass at 1450 Hz. Original FMER; GPL-3.0-only.
